scope: Final clean-image native ServiceJobs journal lifecycle; no mailbox, circuit or connected Messenger journey claim
limitations: Every backend ran on one x86-64 development host; AArch64 assembly ran under qemu-aarch64, not native ARM hardware.
Elapsed seconds measure native transition sequence only, excluding startup and later restart checks.
Provider completion is a controlled journal assertion over the actual19553-byte ServiceJobs source commitment, not a network transmission or recipient acceptance.
Backings were fresh explicit per-run operator images; the40-operation QEMU sequence reused one physical row without reboot or capacity increase.
Execution and source checking do not prove compiler correctness, physical power-loss durability, malicious whole-store rollback detection or independent cryptographic review.
